comments.name: Anne-Marie Lambert
comments.message:
Wow, watching the forest come to life with new buds and leaves, and even some flowers and insects, has been amazing. It's hard to believe they were all lonely sticks in the snow over the winter. 
Watching our Phenology Project volunteers learn and track each phenophase and start to build a new community of forest citizen-scientists has been just as amazing.

comments.name: AJ Shaw
comments.message: The forest looks very nice in the snow! I'm excited to see it in spring time.

comments.name: Ruth
comments.message: As a first-time visitor to the garden, it was wonderful to discover that the "nametags" on the trees included the names of the folks and families who had fostered them. A big thank you to the 275 people who helped create this beautiful forest!
